successCriteria.description: Employee.employmentStatus is typed as EmploymentStatus enum (imported from ../../shared/types), not as string
LeavePolicy.leaveType is typed as LeaveType enum (imported from ../../shared/types), not as string
ILeavePolicyService.getPolicyForLeaveType parameter leaveType is typed as LeaveType enum, not as string
ILeavePolicyService.validateEntitlement parameter leaveType is typed as LeaveType enum, not as string
IEmployeeRepository.softDelete returns Promise<Employee | null> (the soft-deleted entity), consistent with the update method's return pattern, not Promise<boolean>

constraints: Must not change the shape of Employee or LeavePolicy entities beyond type annotation fixes — no field additions, removals, or renames
Must not change IEmployeeRepository or ILeavePolicyRepository method signatures beyond the return-type fix for softDelete — no method additions or removals
Must not introduce any runtime logic, concrete classes, or new files — this is a type-annotation-only fix phase

entityInvariants.invariant: employmentStatus must be typed as EmploymentStatus enum, not as string — the enum values (active | inactive | terminated) are the only valid states
leaveType must be typed as LeaveType enum, not as string — the enum values (annual | sick | emergency) are the only valid leave types

interfaceConstraints.authRule: No auth rule at interface level — auth is enforced at the controller/route layer per GP-005

consistencyRequirements.requirement: LeavePolicy.leaveType and ILeavePolicyService method parameters must use the LeaveType enum imported from src/shared/types/index.ts — the import already exists but is unused; the field and parameters must reference it
Employee.employmentStatus must use the EmploymentStatus enum from src/shared/types/index.ts — add the import and replace the string type

IEmployeeRepository.softDelete return type must match the pattern established by update (Promise<Employee | null>), not Promise<boolean> — the reconciled architecture and PLAN.md both describe softDelete as setting deletedAt and returning the entity
